d:
A comic about accepting oneself's outward appearancce while still acting without compromising to satisfy society's expectation. It covers delicate themes without being preachy or lecturing, in a genuine way.

A crossover between Frol and Bridget, Frol pretty much the inspiration from the 1980s that allowed Bridget to be born by the mind of Daisuke Ishiwatari - Frol belongs to an hermaphrodite sci-fi human subspiecies that can choose to turn fully male or fully woman only once during life time, as in canon from the movie.

Bridget is instead a young boy that crossdresses because an odd custom from his home village, he took a liking to it but wants to prove the world to be masculine fully by being a bounty hunter.

Some eye-candy bonus artworks at the end.
